versions.changelog:
golang-dependency-injection v1.3.0

- Expanded compatibility description to mention Codex and similar harnesses, in addition to Claude Code.
- Added explicit file path pattern under `paths` (now matches all `.go` files).
- Introduced "Orchestration mode" with multi-agent parallelism for large codebase refactoring.
- Removed the deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
- Updated metadata to version 1.3.0.

- Now user-invocable: lets users explicitly invoke this skill.
- Clarified that for specific Go DI libraries, dedicated skills are available and referenced their names.
- Updated version metadata to 1.2.1.

- Added AskUserQuestion to the allowed tools, enabling interactive user prompts.
- Updated skill version to 1.1.2 in metadata.

- Updated skill version to 1.1.1 in metadata.
- No functional or documentation changes; version bump only.

Version 1.1.0 of golang-dependency-injection skill:

- Expanded and clarified content on dependency injection with a comprehensive guide.
- Added best practices summary and clear recommendations for when to use manual DI vs. libraries.
- Included detailed DI library comparison table (google/wire, uber-go/dig, uber-go/fx, samber/do) with criteria.
- Described skill usage scenarios (design mode, refactor mode) and default persona.
- Improved guidance for refactoring tightly coupled code using parallel analysis sub-agents.
- Enhanced practical examples and “Why DI?” rationale for Go projects.
